keyCustody: genuine Ed25519 journal and witness keys generated only in memory; no private-key export or persistence
recreationScope: serialized model states reconstructed as new instances inside one Node process; fixture retains key/client capability custody; no physical process-kill or remote/power-loss proof
acknowledgementContract: already-sent SQL acknowledgement can finish after caller timeout once exact source commit, journal observation and independent head were durable; original status capability recovers; no optional SQL timeout eligibility guard
scope: dedicated scratch contract prototype only; fake SQL source, logical scheduler, create-only record model and independent checkpoint model; no live core/SQL/provider/config/deployment/Git changes
integrationCaveats: Checkpoint CAS atomicity is modeled synchronously; actual provider/process atomicity, private credentials and immutable object-version admission remain unproved.
Prewrite progress validation requires a real bounded fixed-source original-acceptance observer helper/grant, not current app/worker raw access.
Absolute pinned local verifier paths require explicit reviewed repinning in another checkout.
